top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turns binding into elimination through a ternary complex whose cooperativity is a measurable, predictive design variable; the principle is reproduced across many laboratories and E3 ligases. Crews and Deshaies supply the concept and proof of principle, Ciulli the structure-guided design that made it rational chemistry. The citation is kept on bifunctional E3 recruitment and claims no clinical success; the omission of Sakamoto, Kim, Handa, Ito and Gray must be defended openly. P002 (Pd-catalysed C-N coupling) is mature and well attributed but continues a field honoured in 2010, so I rank it second, above no award.
